name: Alliant Energy Corporation
moat_justification: Exclusive regulated electric and gas franchises in Iowa and Wisconsin (Interstate Power & Light, Wisconsin Power & Light) with captive, essential-service demand and a rate base guided from $15.3B in 2025 to $26.2B in 2029 on a $13.4B 2026-2029 capex plan — a durable, visible compounding machine. Capped at 5 because regulators in Iowa and Wisconsin set the allowed ROE and recovery so there is no pricing power beyond rate cases, measured ROIC has stayed low at 4.0-6.0% over 2020-2025 (fundamentals.json roic_proxy), and the plan is funded with debt (net debt $11.560B) plus recurring equity issuance (share count +0.87%/yr).
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
SHARES_FALLBACK: no diluted share count filed for 2016 — those history years use the basic / outstanding / dei count recorded in the shares_tag column; per-share history there is approximate
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Utilities sector — OE/capex DCF fits utilities names poorly; grade confidence low
one_liner: Regulated IA/WI franchise, moat 5/10, but conservative owner's earnings are negative in all of the last 5 years and on TTM (capex exceeds OCF; normalized base -$3.49/share, TTM -$3.10/share) — Tier F on this screen; guided 5-7%+ EPS growth does not clear 15% and no hurdle-clearing price is computable on a negative OE base.
moat_for: Exclusive regulated electric and gas franchises in Iowa and Wisconsin — captive, essential-service customers (IPL and WPL)
$13.4B capex plan 2026-2029 guided to grow rate base from $15.3B (2025) to $26.2B (2029), largely recovered through rates
Contracted data-center load: 5 executed electric service agreements, 3 GW+ contracted, expected to lift demand ~60% by 2031
Long dividend history — 17 growth years in fundamentals.json, DPS TTM $2.0575, 2026 target $2.14/share
moat_against: Regulators cap returns — Iowa and Wisconsin commissions set allowed ROE and recovery; no pricing power beyond rate cases
Measured ROIC is low — roic_proxy 4.57% / 4.54% / 6.00% / 5.78% / 4.04% / 4.29% in 2020-2025, at or below cost of capital
Growth is debt- plus equity-funded: net debt $11.560B and share count +0.87%/yr dilutes rate-base growth per share
Heavy capex concentration in data-center load — delays, cost overruns or tougher rate treatment for large-load customers hit the plan directly
